Fortrea is pleased to participate in OCT Nordics 2026, bringing together clinical research professionals, biotech innovators, and pharmaceutical leaders from across the Nordic region and beyond.


**Visit Booth #42 to learn how Fortrea supports:**


- Clinical development strategy and execution
- Global and regional clinical trials
- Biometrics and data solutions
- Patient recruitment and retention
- Regulatory and consulting services
- End-to-end development solutions across therapeutic areas


We look forward to meeting you and discussing your clinical development goals.
